Bayer's unallocated costs are then shared by sales: All Other Segments' EBITDA before special items of 277mm, Enabling Functions and Consolidation's -662mm, 45mm of restructuring in the Reconciliation and the 426mm of group capital expenditure the three segments do not report, -856mm in all, of which 39.40% (-337mm) is this segment's share of the 45,253mm the three segments sell. The three lines above leave 3,790mm, so the charge takes 720mm, 4.0398% of sales, and the segment keeps 3,070mm. Before interest: the target is struck above the financial result. Checked at replacement capex: Bayer does not split plant depreciation from amortisation by segment, so the charge carries the capital expenditure each segment reports in cash. Without one-off cash: litigation special items (group EUR 7,455mm in 2025) are left out and the provisions they built are carried as claims on equity instead; divestment gains are left out. Restated without working capital build: EBITDA is struck before working capital, so the build is charged on growth by the book instead. Across the three segments the targets sum to 6,587mm, which is the group's EBITDA before special items of 9,669mm less 595mm of restructuring and 2,487mm of capital expenditures
